title.narrative: BT - IDF Grant for Bhutan C&AG's Office

description.narrative: The objective of the Grant is to assist the Recipient in its efforts to build a strong financial management and public accountability framework, increase skills in accounting and budgeting, and strengthen its management training institute. The activities (the Activities) for which the Grant is given are as follows: (a) for the purposes of drafting a National Finance Act: (i) the identifying of key facets of finance law, including involving stakeholders; (ii) the carrying out of workshops to document key issues and resolutions; and (iii) the drafting of key elements of finance law; (b) for the purposes of strengthening the Departments of Aid and Debt Management (DADM), and National Finance Service (NFS): (i) the documenting of immediate, medium-term, and long-term training requirements for NFS and internal audit staff; (ii) the developing of pre-service and in-service training strategy, and exploring of possibilities for professional accreditation and increasing the role of Royal Institute of Management (RIM); (iii) the carrying out of specialized external training for immediate staff requirements; and (iv) the developing of medium-term training modules with RIM and delivering training to NFS and internal audit staff; (c) for the purposes of strengthening the Department of Budget and Accounts (DBA) program management and budgeting capacity, carrying out of study tours and provision of technical assistance; and (d) for the purposes of strengthening RIM: (i) the evaluating and refining of current curriculum and development of new curricula for key staff; (ii) the appraising of distance learning options and capacity and resource requirements; (iii) the identifying of institutions and exploring opportunities for partnership and providing accreditation; (iv) the evaluating and extending of RIMs capacity to accommodate NFS and internal audit requirements; (v) the strengthening of the faculty and teaching methodologies, including training the trainers; (vi) the procuring of instructional materials, books, journals, and training aids to increase RIM delivery capacity; and (vi) the carrying out of staff training pilots in accounting and internal audit.
